qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Prime central business district office and retail locations in Zurich and Geneva provide asset scarcity, but commercial landlord leasing lacks structural switching costs, network effects, or super-normal returns on capital.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3 (Moat & Pricing: ROIC 2.5-3.5% vs 12% hurdle; archetype 'None', REJECT). High-quality Swiss commercial property portfolio in prime Zurich and Geneva locations; conservatively managed, but prime property yields of 3.0-3.5% structurally fail the 12% ROIC threshold.
qualitative.evidence: Normalized GAAP ROIC tracks at 2.5-3.5%, constrained by prime Swiss commercial property capitalization rates (3.0-3.5% net yields). Conservative balance sheet with LTV ~30% protects capital, but does not overcome sub-hurdle capital efficiency.
